source: GENERATED from interview-app/schema/intake_fields.js (PRES-006 canonical field-path contract) — edit the contract, not this file. tools/gen_ui_questions.mjs regenerates pages/index.html and this snapshot in one pass so the form can never disagree with the Workers' schema-driven completeness gate. (deployed-r2/public/index.html is PRES-005-owned and server-driven — not regenerated.)
description: Curated intake question set for the Presentation Interview app, GENERATED from the one canonical field-path contract. Every question id, prompt, kind, allowed_values, value_labels, storeOn and conditional_on comes from schema/intake_fields.js. The upsell yes/no flags and their verbatim declined-reason waivers store canonically under pre_presentation_capture.* (the storeTarget home every engine consumer reads); the Workers gate completeness against the same contract. Cap 20; this set is 18.

questions.prompt: What kind of presentation do you need?
questions.help: This is the first thing we need to know — it decides how we build everything else in your brief, from structure to length.
questions.label: Presentation type

value_labels.from_scratch: From scratch — brainstorm and build a brand-new presentation
value_labels.content_personal: From something I already have, for ONE specific person
value_labels.content_general: From something I already have, for a room or wider audience
value_labels.signature: The full Signature Presentation (100+ slides, multi-part keynote)

questions.prompt: What are you selling at the end — the exact name of your product or offer?
questions.help: The offer sold at the end of the presentation — never invented.
questions.label: Offer name

questions.prompt: Do you have a named methodology, framework, or system you deliver this through — what is it called, in your own words?
questions.help: The branded method name — client-supplied only, never invented for you. If you don’t have a named method, say so plainly (e.g. ‘no formal name, we just do X’) rather than inventing one — an honest ‘no’ is still a real answer.
questions.label: Named methodology
questions.placeholder: e.g. The Three-Move Pipeline System, or 'no formal name'

questions.prompt: What’s the before-and-after this offer delivers — who are they before, and who are they after?
questions.help: The transformation promise drives the whole arc.
questions.label: Transformation promise
questions.placeholder: e.g. stuck and overwhelmed → clear, confident, closing

questions.prompt: How long does it typically take a client to see this result once they start — the real, honest timeframe?
questions.help: State the true delivery timeframe in your own words (e.g. ‘8 weeks’, ‘about 3 sessions’, or ‘it varies, typically N weeks’) — never a faster number to sound more impressive.
questions.label: Time to result
questions.placeholder: e.g. 8 weeks to final, a shift in 2

questions.help: Industry, income level, and the pain point that brought them here. This seeds the audience-engine.
questions.label: Audience
questions.placeholder: e.g. women entrepreneurs, 35-55, tired of inconsistent clients

questions.prompt: What is the exact call-to-action — the verb and next step you want them to take?
questions.help: This drives the closing slide’s action language.
questions.label: Call to action
questions.placeholder: e.g. book a call, buy the program, join the waitlist

questions.prompt: Do you have a logo or brand colors for the slides?
questions.help: If no logo is on file, provide one here — or we build without one and stay on-brand to the presentation system.
questions.label: Logo

questions.prompt: Paste any image links you want used in the deck.
questions.help: Product photos, headshots, brand imagery. Optional — add up to 5.
questions.label: Image links

questions.prompt: Pick a tone — Inspirational, Tough Love, Challenger, Teacher, Storyteller, High-Energy Hype, or Calm Premium.
questions.help: One of the seven named styles, or blend two.
questions.label: Tone

questions.prompt: What is the final price of the offer?
questions.help: The offer price only — what a buyer pays at the end. Set 0 if this is a free-only close.
questions.label: Final price

questions.prompt: At what pace should we record the audio narration?
questions.help: default = recommended setting, medium = slightly faster, fast = high energy.
questions.label: Speech speed

questions.prompt: Do you need a sales page and checkout page along with the presentation?
questions.help: Default yes. A no records a client waiver — you keep the deck and optionally a VSL page.
questions.label: Sales page + checkout

value_labels.yes: Yes, build the sales page and checkout page

questions.prompt: Understood — no sales page or checkout page. In your own words, why don’t you want it? (I record this verbatim so nobody later has to guess.)
questions.help: Asked only when you declined the sales + checkout pages. Stored word-for-word as your waiver — an empty answer cannot be accepted.
questions.label: Why no sales/checkout page
questions.placeholder: e.g. we only need the deck for this launch

questions.prompt: Would you like a VSL page — a video sales letter — along with this?
questions.help: Default no — a VSL page needs the video to exist first.
questions.label: VSL page

questions.prompt: No VSL page, understood. In your own words, why not? (Recorded verbatim as your waiver.)
questions.help: Asked only when you declined the VSL page. Stored word-for-word — an empty answer cannot be accepted.
questions.label: Why no VSL page
questions.placeholder: e.g. we have no hosted video yet

questions.prompt: How hard should we run the build of this deck?
questions.help: This is about the BUILD, not this interview. Skip it and you get Standard — we never put a run on Ultra unless you asked for it.
questions.label: Run mode

value_labels.ultra: Ultra — highest concurrency and strongest model mix (fastest, most expensive)

questions.prompt: Anything else important we should know before we start?
questions.help: Extras: target slide count, deadline, proof assets, anything else. Optional.
questions.label: Notes
